records.speaker: Ensemble
records.trigger: Contributors return from collection points; door convergence

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: I said I could bring everyone together. I should have specified a doorway.

text.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
text.text: Three loads. Three openings. Use the cues.

source_obligations: Turn-based delivery puzzle starts only after P12; keep supplied good line.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Look at cue-command rack
records.text: Each cue shows the load, its route and any blocked lane before we move. Nobody goes until we choose. I can take a breath without missing dinner.
source_obligations: Visible load/width/destination/occupied markers; each route choice a turn, no timer.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Interface
records.trigger: Route hotspot
records.text: House doorway
source_obligations: People/board route via front door and rear arch.

records.speaker: Interface
records.trigger: Route hotspot
records.text: Kitchen hatch
source_obligations: Object-only food route directly to buffet.

records.speaker: Interface
records.trigger: Route hotspot
records.text: Side gate
source_obligations: Folded display/cart route, tested peg holds open.

records.speaker: Route preview
records.trigger: Select SERVE cue
records.text: SERVE. People: house doorway, then rear arch. Lidded pot: kitchen hatch to buffet. Keep the guest lane clear.
source_obligations: Does not auto-execute any delivery; clear known routes.

records.speaker: Route preview
records.trigger: Select SHOW cue
records.text: SHOW. Folded display on handcart: side gate to display alcove. Gate held on its peg. Reveal after dinner, when Rita is ready.
source_obligations: Folded width, gate state, destination, consent/order preserved.

records.speaker: Route preview
records.trigger: Select TOAST cue
records.text: TOAST. Pledge board: house doorway after the guest queue clears. Call attention with the microphone, then pull the TOAST cue.
source_obligations: After first two cues only; normal route; no coercion.

records.speaker: Interface
records.trigger: Guest-program card name
records.text: Guest-program card
source_obligations: Offered at P13 start, not hidden earlier pickup.

records.speaker: Guest-program card
records.trigger: Read program
records.text: Milo greets at the front door. Guests use the living-room rear arch to reach their courtyard places. Once the queue is clear, Milo takes his place. SERVE, SHOW, TOAST.
source_obligations: All contributors including Milo seated, defined route.

records.speaker: Interface
records.trigger: Pledge board name
records.text: Blank pledge board
source_obligations: Offered at P13 start; later matching cards supplied P14.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Look at blank pledge board
records.text: Eight places for eight actual commitments. I’ve never seen a blank board look so much like Frankie.
source_obligations: Board records responsibilities, no signature yet.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Give program to Milo and request greeter role
records.text: Please greet at the front door. Send everyone through the rear arch. Then join us.
source_obligations: Milo directs guests, then himself; no abandonment of assigned role.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Ensemble
records.trigger: Milo receives program and clears guest route

text.speaker: Milo Pennant
text.text: Front door, living room, rear arch. Everyone to their courtyard places, then I sit down.

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: No little speech in the doorway.

text.speaker: Milo Pennant
text.text: May I say “this way”? I’ve got to let some of it out.

source_obligations: People follow defined path and take positions, Milo last; queue clears.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Bunny Easter
records.trigger: Ask helper about pot load
records.text: The lidded pot goes through the hatch, straight to the buffet. I’ll help you pass it.
source_obligations: Repeatable load/destination reminder.

records.speaker: Felix Bunt
records.trigger: Ask helper about display load
records.text: Folded display, on the cart, through the side gate. Proper peg in. Rita says when.
source_obligations: Repeatable load/route/peg/permission reminder.

records.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
records.trigger: Ask helper about pledge-board load
records.text: I’ll bring the board through the house once the guest queue clears. Then we can call the toast.
source_obligations: Board route and prerequisite repeatable.

records.speaker: Bunny Easter
records.trigger: Use lidded pot with kitchen hatch, correct delivery
records.text: Straight through. Frankie’s cleared the buffet and opened the bowls. There’s supper.
source_obligations: Jackie+Bunny deliver, Frankie clear/unpack; correct buffet already placed.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Pull SERVE cue after actual food delivery
records.text: SERVE complete. Eight tasting bowls. Mine’s one of them. Bunny can stop counting my spoonfuls.
source_obligations: SERVED only after people/food correct; tasting not magical full meals; completed delivery retained.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Bunny Easter
records.trigger: Attempt pot via occupied house route
records.text: The guest queue is in the way. The hatch puts us straight over the buffet. Back to the kitchen.
source_obligations: Reset only pot delivery; keep completed work; original direct clue preserved.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Attempt to send people through hatch
records.text: People use the house door and rear arch. Dinner goes through the hatch. If we confuse those, I’ll have to garnish Milo.
source_obligations: People stay start positions; no injury; limited first wrong-route laugh only.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Felix Bunt
records.trigger: Attempt display through narrow hatch
records.text: Even folded, the display is wider than the hatch. Use the side gate. We’re not serving Rita’s work in slices.
source_obligations: Obvious width preview, no breakage, reset this delivery only.
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Rita Stringer
records.trigger: Attempt SHOW before SERVE
records.text: Dinner first. Hungry people look at ceramic bowls for the wrong reason.
source_obligations: Agreed order; no relationship penalty.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Ask Rita explicit reveal readiness after dinner
records.text: Are you ready to show everyone your panel?
source_obligations: Required consent, valid only after meal served.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Rita Stringer
records.trigger: Rita grants reveal cue
records.text: Yes. Bring it through the side gate. Once it’s in place, open the screen. I’d like to tell them about it myself.
source_obligations: KNOW_DISPLAY_PERMISSION explicit; maker controls presentation.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Request Felix and Vivian existing transport
records.text: Felix, Vivian, please bring the folded display through the pegged side gate.
source_obligations: Willing helpers, cart, tested peg; route correct.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Ensemble
records.trigger: Transport display/cart through gate into footprint

text.speaker: Felix Bunt
text.text: Gate held. Folded width clear. Bringing it through.

text.speaker: Vivian Voss
text.text: Into the marked footprint. Keep it concealed behind the screen.

text.speaker: Felix Bunt
text.text: Thank you for noticing the gate. Even if I had to say it myself.

source_obligations: Folded display stays safe and concealed until footprint and reveal permission.
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Vivian Voss
records.trigger: Use screen pull tab before display reaches footprint
records.text: Wait until the display is in its marked place. At present, we’d be unveiling the wall.
source_obligations: Do not reveal before positioned; no new gate.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Use pull tab after display in footprint and Rita ready
records.text: Opening the viewing side. Rita, it’s yours.
source_obligations: Open only viewing side; retain clear circulation and reveal control.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Ensemble
records.trigger: Rita presents uncovered original panel

text.speaker: Rita Stringer
text.text: I made this for the house. Three doors, one table. I tried separate tables. It looked lonely.

text.speaker: Rita Stringer
text.text: I put room for you in it. You can decide where to sit.

text.speaker: Rita Stringer
text.text: Yes. You’ve been eating off my other work for years. I wanted one you couldn’t put gravy on.

source_obligations: Original three differently colored doors around shared table; Rita authorship, no imitation prop; warmth unhurried.
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Pull SHOW cue after Rita presentation
records.text: SHOW complete. Rita’s panel, presented by Rita. I didn’t have to explain a single thing on her behalf.
source_obligations: DISPLAY_REVEALED; no automatic toast/signature.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
records.trigger: Give board to Frankie once arrival queue clear
records.text: I’ll take the board through the house. The route’s clear now.
source_obligations: Front/rear ordinary route, no teleport, no people through hatch.

records.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
records.trigger: Attempt board delivery while guest queue occupies route
records.text: Milo must get everyone seated first. Then I can carry the board through the house. It’s wide enough without a guest on each end.
source_obligations: Names actual occupied-lane prerequisite; reset only board delivery.
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Use correctly oriented microphone for toast
records.text: Everyone, a moment. We’ve fed you and shown you Rita’s work. Now let’s say what we’re actually agreeing to.
source_obligations: Calls attention after SERVED+DISPLAY_REVEALED and board ready; voluntary Stringer.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Pull TOAST cue after required deliveries and VC04_RESOLVED
records.text: TOAST. Everybody here, board ready. No one has to promise anything they didn’t agree to.
source_obligations: TOAST_READY; independent completed cues preserved.
VC04_RESOLVED is required for TOAST_READY after the existing food/show/board prerequisites.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged

records.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
records.trigger: Attempt TOAST before SERVE and SHOW complete
records.text: Food first, then Rita’s presentation. The promises will keep until we’ve kept those two.
source_obligations: No skipping cue sequence or dependencies.

records.speaker: Jackie Tree
records.trigger: Attempt disruptive movement of occupied furniture after delivery
records.text: That’s in use. If I move it now, somebody will spend the rest of supper holding their bowl and being polite about it.
source_obligations: Protect occupied furniture only after relevant delivery, in-world explanation.
records.name_revision: Jackie Tree; internal jack identifiers unchanged
records.revision_status: Language revision 2 proposal; not yet applied to game sources.

records.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
records.trigger: Overlay detects previously optional furniture move invalidating delivery
records.text: {blocked_place_name} is blocked. Put the furniture back on its plan mark before we send this load.
source_obligations: Same pre-existing spatial prerequisite; actual affected marker highlighted; no pixel-perfect position.

dynamic_bindings.blocked_place_name: The already-failed route or landing-place condition named by the existing overlay.

records.speaker: Hint
records.trigger: Request hint level 1
records.text: Use the three routes you prepared, in SERVE, SHOW, TOAST order.
source_obligations: Optional requested hint; no automatic speech or progression.

records.speaker: Hint
records.trigger: Request hint level 2
records.text: People use the house door. Food goes straight through the kitchen hatch. The wide display needs the side gate.
source_obligations: Optional requested hint; no automatic speech or progression.

records.speaker: Hint
records.trigger: Request hint level 3
records.text: Give Milo the program to seat everyone. Pass the lidded pot through the hatch and pull SERVE. Get Rita’s permission, send the display through the pegged gate, open the screen and pull SHOW. Send Frankie with the board through the clear house, use the microphone, and pull TOAST.
source_obligations: Optional requested hint; no automatic speech or progression.

records.speaker: Ensemble
records.trigger: After SERVED, DISPLAY_REVEALED and pledge-board delivery; before TOAST_READY

text.speaker: Mr. Stringer
text.text: Supper has been served, Rita has presented her work, and the board is here. Who gets the ceremonial flourish?

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: A brief household-led toast, or your limited introduction. The actual commitments stay as agreed.

text.speaker: Mr. Stringer
text.text: Yes. Just the form of the toast. Practice first, or begin?

source_obligations: Introduce only the canonical narrow stake.
Practical rewards, truthful credits and personal boundaries are not wagered.

records.speaker: Mr. Stringer
records.trigger: Request another attempt after any concluded result
records.text: A rematch, on the same narrow terms. We can practice first.
source_obligations: Future last-word variants may change; past words and protected facts cannot.

records.speaker: Interface
records.trigger: Attempt to start this contest before its canonical prerequisites
records.text: Serve supper, let Rita present her work, and bring the pledge board here first.
source_obligations: Block only the stated canonical entry conditions; no new gate or penalty.

records.speaker: Interface
records.trigger: Attempt the readiness/introduction/toast step without this contest resolved
records.text: Complete one contest attempt with Mr. Stringer before the toast is ready. The meal, presentation and board delivery remain complete.
source_obligations: A concluded loss resolves this step; only the final P14 gate requires all four eventual wins.
